# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Canonical guidance for working in this repository — architecture, commands,
known issues, and monorepo layout — lives in [`CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md) at the
repo root (and [`apps/ai_agent/CLAUDE.md`](../apps/ai_agent/CLAUDE.md) for the
backend). Read those first.

This file exists only because GitHub Copilot looks for instructions at this
specific path; it intentionally doesn't duplicate the content above to avoid
two descriptions of the codebase drifting apart.
